shortDescription: Module for configuring Interfaces in AOS-CX switches.

options.name: acl_direction
options.description: Direction for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: Name of the ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: autoneg
options.description: Configure the auto-negotiation state of the interface. If `off` both `speeds`, and `duplex` are required.

options.name: configure_speed
options.description: Option to configure speed/duplex in the interface. It `true`, `autoneg` is required.

options.name: duplex
options.description: Configure the interface for full duplex or half duplex. If `autoneg`is `on` this must be omitted.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Administrative state of the interface. Use true to administratively enable it.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Configure MTU value of the interface

options.name: name
options.description: Interface name, should be in the format chassis/slot/port, e.g. 1/2/3, 1/2/32.

options.name: no_qos
options.description: Flag to remove the existing QoS schedule profile of the interface. use true to remove it. This option is mutually exclusive with the qos option.

options.name: qos
options.description: Name of existing QoS schedule profile to apply to interface. This option is mutually exclusive with the no_qos option.

options.name: qos_rate
options.description: The rate limit value configured for broadcast/multicast/unknown unicast traffic.

options.name: qos_trust_mode
options.description: Specifies the interface QoS Trust Mode. 'global' configures the interface to use the global configuration.

options.name: queue_profile
options.description: Name of queue profile to apply to interface.

options.name: speeds
options.description: Configure the speeds of the interface in megabits per second. If `duplex` is defined only one speed may be specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, Update or Delete the Interface.

options.name: use_global_queue_profile
options.description: Option to use the switch's global Queue Profile. This option is mutually exclusive with the queue_profile option.

options.name: vsx_sync
options.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers.
